name: 5-MABB
summary: 5-MBPB (also known as 5-MPBP and 5-MABB) is an amphetamine and phenylisobutylamine derivative which is structurally related to MDMA and has been sold as a designer drug. It can be described as the benzofuran-5-yl analogue of MBDB or the butanamine homologue of 5-MAPB, and is also a structural isomer of 5-EAPB and 6-EAPB.

pharmacology.text: 5-MBPB is similar in structure to compounds such as 5-APB which are claimed to be agonists of the 5-HT2C receptor. 5-MBPB (5-MABB) has been found to act as a potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA), with preference for induction of serotonin release over norepinephrine and dopamine release, and fully substitutes for MDMA in animal drug discrimination tests.

uses.text: 5-MBPB (also known as 5-MPBP and 5-MABB) is an amphetamine and phenylisobutylamine derivative which is structurally related to MDMA and has been sold as a designer drug. Anecdotal reports suggest this compound has been sold as a designer drug in various European countries since early 2015, but the first definitive identification was made in December 2015 by a forensic laboratory in Slovenia.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: It is a structural isomer of 6-MABB and a relative of MBDB, one of the entactogens David Nichols's group made while mapping which shapes give MDMA-like effects.
fact.zh: 它是6-MABB的結構異構物，也是MBDB的近親；MBDB是David Nichols團隊在研究哪些分子形狀能產生類MDMA作用時製作的同理心增強劑之一。
fact.zhHans: 它是6-MABB的结构异构物，也是MBDB的近亲；MBDB是David Nichols团队在研究哪些分子形状能产生类MDMA作用时制作的同理心增强剂之一。
